overview.title: The library — what this engine is
overview.what: acquire → hold → serve / find-gaps / grow — the stock the whole project reads from
body: The library is the corpus the Grammar-of-Meaning project reads: a strong, bias-visible, durably-backed store of primary sources across traditions. It is not a pipeline stage — it is the stock every other engine operates on. Its job: make it easy to locate + acquire the sources we need, from a VARIETY of origins (African / Latin American / Asian / oral / non-English), not just the Anglophone workhorses.

The library does not only hold — it audits its own silence. LACUNA names what is missing by set-difference against a NAMED external authority (a clavis), so "missing" stops meaning "a machine didn't recall it" and starts meaning "a named scholarly authority says it exists and we don't hold it."

logic.title: Inputs → engine → outputs
logic.what: the black-box logic statement (every step: input · transform · output · gate)
body: (1) a primary text / reading; (2) a coverage gap surfaced by the morphospace atlas; (3) a clavis (external authority enumerating a literature).

ACQUIRE (CRADLE classify→route→resolve→dedup→gateway; §2.8 Parity fires non-Western with equal priority) → HOLD (sources + L4 passages; dual-store SQLite+Neon) → SERVE (held passages → the method instrument) · FIND-GAPS (LACUNA recall-vs-clavis) · GROW (silences → desiderata → acquire → round-trip closes them).
(1) held, chunked passages the instrument codes; (2) a cited gap-map + shopping list; (3) a defensible self-audit (held vs registered; recall vs clavis).
no memory-enumeration — a silence must be an evidenced discrepancy vs a named authority; every acquisition routes through the gateway (provenance + dedup, §2.7).

corpus.title: The corpus — what we hold
corpus.what: sources · passages — the stock we hold
body:
65,650 held as full text  ·  of 376,726 registered  ·  142 silences named

Held = >300 chars of real text (excerpts excluded — a snippet is not full text): 17.4% of registered, across 12.85M passages. The honest 3-part count — registered / held / reference — is first-class here; naming all three is the anti-inflation discipline (corpus_headline_count_matches_db.py guards it from drift).

audit.title: Audit — recall vs clavis (the reflexive rigor)
audit.what: the library measures its own blindness against named authorities
body: Recall vs clavis = the % of a named authority's enumerated entries for which our corpus holds ≥1 witness. A silence = the residual (authority − holdings), each carrying the authority's citation (a clavis_number) so a third party can check it.

Clavis: Syriaca.org (machine-readable LOD). Reference population: 128 Syriac authors attested as author of ≥1 work.
RECALL = 7.0%  ·  9/128 held  ·  119 cited silences

We hold the canonical/Greek-transmitted fathers + 3 famous Syriac (Ephrem, Jacob of Serugh, Aphrahat) — and are blind to the native tradition. Top silences (acquire first):

  • ʿEnanishoʿ — Syriaca attests 155 works (474)
  • Narsai — Syriaca attests 109 works (650)
  • Jacob of Edessa — Syriaca attests 80 works (113)
  • John of Ephesus — Syriaca attests 62 works (74)
  • Palladius of Aspuna — Syriaca attests 59 works (668)
  • George Warda — Syriaca attests 44 works (504)
  • Jerome — Syriaca attests 35 works (857)
  • Eusebius of Caesarea — Syriaca attests 33 works (480)

Deterministic candidate-generation (distinctive-token subset) → LLM adjudication (Haiku, temp 0, every verdict logged) rejects false matches (Syriac "Thomas" ≠ Thomas Hobbes; "John Rufus" ≠ Musonius Rufus). The number is defensible because the matcher is auditable, not because it is generous.
The reflexive finding (the clavis has silences too)

Syriaca.org does not enumerate gospel commentaries (0 of 2,824 works; even Ephrem's Diatessaron Commentary is absent). The choice of clavis determines which silences are visible — so gospel-commentary exegesis needs a PRINT clavis (Baumstark / CPG). A validated audit is not one with no blind spots; it is one whose blind spots are named.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.what: the stages, the store, the scripts
body: STAGE 0 define reference population (clavis) · STAGE 1 the fill (set-difference) · STAGE 2 measure (recall) · STAGE 5 queue (durable desiderata). Each is a black box: input → transform → output → gate (§2.15).

silence_finding (142 rows; 120 carry a clavis URI) — dual-store SQLite + Neon (§2.13). Each silence: type · wall · lifecycle · fill_provenance (endpoint-enumeration vs ai-memory-flagged) · status (identified→…→held/blocked; blocked never closes).
